notes.Netailove: Village on the Vovcha west of Pervomaiske, on the road from Avdiivka towards Pokrovsk; fought over in the spring and summer of 2024 after Avdiivka fell.
notes.Novoselivka Persha: Large village on the Vovcha north-west of Avdiivka, where the O0542 from Lastochkyne and Orlivka runs on to the west; fought over in the summer of 2024.
notes.Karlivka: Village on the dam of the Karlivka reservoir (Vovcha): the crossing that anchored the Ukrainian line south-west of the salient in 2024.
notes.Prohres: Village on the rail line and road from Ocheretyne towards Pokrovsk; fought over in the spring of 2024.
notes.Sokil: Small village north-west of Ocheretyne; fought over in the spring of 2024.
notes.Yevhenivka: Village west of Ocheretyne on the road towards Pokrovsk.
notes.Yasnobrodivka: Hamlet on the Vovcha west of Tonenke.
notes.Komyshivka: Village in the rear of the Ukrainian line west of Novoselivka Persha.
notes.Halytsynivka: Village on the Vovcha upstream of the Karlivka reservoir; Ukrainian rear area.
notes.Blahodatne: Large village on the Pokrovsk road in the Ukrainian rear.
notes.Kalynove: Village on the north shore of the Karlivka reservoir.
notes.Zavitne: Village in the Ukrainian rear west of Komyshivka.
